body.p: An ermine. Why does the ermine have a black end of a tail. Because it is a thief. It is a thief, it likes stealing games. Once it entered a tent. It thought it would find something to eat. There is always something in a tent. People saw the ermine. One woman ran screaming after an ermine. And he runs, then jumps, then jumps, then runs. It wants to run away from [ShA:] Å imuÉd is the the tent. He was running and dropped a fire stick. On this stick hung a kettle and a cauldron over the fire.expected form, although with no access to the recording I cannot be sure. This stick was covered in ashes. Since then, the ermine's tail has remained black.
